artifact_review:
The Router reported no artifacts. The Perceptual Quality Auditor confirmed no graphics-level distortions (blur, noise). The Topology Boundary Auditor gave a very high confidence score (0.9993) for the facial ruff mask, indicating clean boundaries without melting or haloing at the skin-fur interface. 

However, the Animal Pose Auditor flagged a HIGH artifact risk (59% low-confidence keypoints). Crucially, the low-confidence keypoints are concentrated in the hind limbs, hips, and lower torso—regions that are either heavily cropped or completely outside the frame. The face and upper torso keypoints (eyes, nose, ears) have high confidence (>0.85). Therefore, the 'HIGH' risk is a false positive caused by domain shift and occlusion/cropping, not structural failure. I disagree with any implication of structural defect based on this expert alone. Visually, the image is clean.
